requirements.quote:
User records are not cleanup candidates. The following paths are
treated as protected user data and refused at scan, plan replay, and

requirements.title: 清理选择与计划重验证：禁止选择 blocked、report-only，谨慎项需显式启用，删除前验证链接和根路径
requirements.quote:
The action plan is the trust boundary: `clean --plan` re-validates every
path against the live filesystem before deleting, refuses to follow new
symlinks, and rejects plans whose roots have changed shape since the
scan.

retrieval_evidence.quote: Discarding a path under a symlinked parent deletes files OUTSIDE the worktree via the rm fallback — data loss beyond the repository.
retrieval_evidence.reason: 共享机制是删除路径经符号链接父目录逃逸出授权根目录。适用于删除前检查完整路径及父目录链；仅检查末级文件或扫描时检查不足以防止计划生成后的链接变化。

retrieval_evidence.quote: The current version marker alone is not proof that each directory is still CodeWhale-owned, and the existing introduced_in shortcut must not overwrite a pre-existing user skill that happens to use a newly bundled name.
retrieval_evidence.reason: 共享机制是历史标记无法证明当前目录仍属工具管理，按旧身份执行变更可能覆盖用户内容。适用于计划重放时重新确认当前根路径和产物身份；该资料未证明具体的符号链接检查实现。

requirements.title: 目标空间提案与时间戳清扫：仅生成可审阅计划，正确处理目标不足、空结果和产物变化
requirements.quote:
`rclean free <size>` computes the smallest safe set that can meet a target
reclaim amount and writes it as an ActionPlan for review. It never deletes by
itself; replay the plan with `rclean clean --plan ... --dry-run` first.
`free --json` emits a versioned proposal containing `targetBytes`,
`selectedBytes`, `targetMet`, `planPath`, and the selected scan candidates.
Exit code `0` means the target was met; exit code `3` means the safe set was
short or empty. A short proposal still writes a reviewable plan, while an empty
proposal reports `planPath: null` and writes none.

requirements.title: 交互清理与恢复：确认后执行可恢复清理，恢复检查目标和链接，批次失败继续且预演无副作用
requirements.quote:
Restore one grave directly with `rclean restore --id <ID>`. Add `--to <PATH>` to
choose another destination. Running `rclean restore` without `--id` on a
terminal opens a newest-first numbered selector that accepts numbers, ranges,
`all`, or `q`, then asks for confirmation. Every selected item still passes
through the same target-exists and symlink checks as a direct restore. A batch
continues after an item is skipped or fails, prints restored/skipped/failed
totals, and exits non-zero when any item was not restored.

retrieval_evidence.quote: It should treat `story-bank.md` as user-layer (never overwrite; merge or skip).
retrieval_evidence.reason: 共享机制是恢复或回滚写入已有用户目标时造成覆盖和数据丢失。可迁移到恢复前的目标存在检查及跳过策略；不提供批次继续、链接检查或预演无副作用的证据。

requirements.title: 筛选、自定义规则与忽略配置：遵守分类后筛选、规则优先级及不同配置错误的失败或告警契约
requirements.quote:
Invalid `--ignore` globs fail the scan. Invalid `.rcleanignore` files are
reported as scan warnings so the scan can continue while still marking the
result as potentially incomplete.

retrieval_evidence.quote: `.gitignore` not taken into account when multiple search paths are provided
retrieval_evidence.reason: 共享机制是多个扫描入口改变忽略规则的应用范围，导致本应排除的文件进入结果。适用于验证多根扫描下忽略配置仍被正确加载和应用；不涉及非法 glob 的失败或告警契约。

requirements.title: 扫描报告与解释：人工和 JSON 输出呈现陈旧度、候选解释及一致的不完整结果告警
requirements.quote:
Scan reports include a top-level `warnings` list for recoverable scan
problems such as invalid `.rcleanignore` files or filesystem walk errors.
The table output prints the same warning summary; JSON consumers should
treat a non-empty `warnings` array as "results may be incomplete."

retrieval_evidence.quote: Only the `--since` flag differs between 2 and 3.
retrieval_evidence.reason: 候选描述同一分页上限截断因筛选参数不同而改变告警内容，属于结果不完整提示随执行分支漂移。适用于检查不同扫描参数下告警含义一致；不直接证明人工输出与 JSON 输出一致。

requirements.title: 管道与输出错误处理：提前关闭无崩溃，保留已确定退出状态，删除前断管必须停止清理
requirements.quote:
Non-interactive stdout is pipe-aware. If a downstream reader closes early
(for example, `rclean rules | head -n 1`), rclean stops writing without a panic
or backtrace and retains any command exit status already determined. Other
stdout I/O errors still fail explicitly. For `clean`, a closed pipe before the
delete phase stops the command before any artifact is removed; if cleanup has
already completed, its computed success or failure status is preserved.

retrieval_evidence.quote: If stdout is closed by downstream consumer (`EPIPE`), `rtk` should terminate cleanly (or return non-zero) without panic/abort/coredump.
retrieval_evidence.reason: 触发条件和故障机制直接一致：下游提前关闭 stdout，未处理 EPIPE 导致 panic 或进程异常终止。可迁移到断管处理；退出状态保留及删除前停止仍需另外验证。

retrieval_evidence.quote: Bug: panic on broken pipe (SIGPIPE) — crash dump when piping codewhale output
retrieval_evidence.reason: 同样是管道消费者关闭后写 stdout 引发崩溃，适用于确认所有输出路径均避免 panic。标题未提供退出码或清理阶段行为的证据。

retrieval_evidence.quote: Some commands which pipe output through a pager, error with `write |1: broken pipe`.
retrieval_evidence.reason: 分页器提前退出触发写管道失败，与需求中的下游提前关闭相同。适用于表格渲染等输出路径统一处理断管；不能据此忽略其他 stdout I/O 错误。

retrieval_evidence.quote: `exit 1` process with piped - does not throw error
retrieval_evidence.reason: 共享机制是管道封装掩盖原命令已经确定的失败状态。适用于验证断管或管道处理不会把既有失败改成成功；候选并未描述 EPIPE 或删除操作。

requirements.title: Docker 只读报告：子进程超时受限、参数使用数组，所有资源均不得进入清理计划或执行删除
requirements.quote:
`docker report` uses the official Docker CLI with bounded subprocess timeouts
and array arguments. It does not call `docker system prune`, `docker builder
prune`, `docker rm`, `docker rmi`, `docker volume rm`, or any other deletion
command. Build cache and dangling-image categories may be classified as
`caution` in the report taxonomy, while volumes, named resources, networks, and
tagged images remain `report-only`; all Docker rows are `selected=false` in this
release.

retrieval_evidence.quote: If subprocess-based detection must remain, run probes in parallel with a short timeout and cache the result instead of serially, so one slow/gated probe can't stall
retrieval_evidence.reason: 共享机制是外部探测子进程迟迟不返回，阻塞只读报告的完成。可迁移的是对子进程等待设置有限超时；并行和缓存不是当前需求的必要扩展，资料也不涉及 Docker 删除隔离。

retrieval_evidence.reason: 候选指出非 TTY 且未提供命令行输入时子进程无限挂起，适用于检查 Docker 报告调用不会等待交互输入，并以超时限制等待。不能推断所有 Docker CLI 调用都具有该触发条件。

retrieval_evidence.quote: Also, the current timeouts seem too aggressive for Windows in some cases:
retrieval_evidence.reason: 共享机制是只读外部探测的超时设置导致可用服务被误判失败。适用于在限制等待时间的同时检查超时结果和平台延迟；不支持取消超时，也不涉及参数注入或删除命令限制。

extraction.symptom: 丢弃符号链接目录下的文件时，可能删除工作树之外的文件。
extraction.root_cause: 正文指出，路径校验将 /repo/link/keep.txt 接受为工作树内路径，但未识别其父目录符号链接指向外部目录；git ls-files 失败后，rm 回退沿该链接删除外部文件。
environment: 工作树内的父目录符号链接指向外部目录
git ls-files --error-unmatch 对目标路径失败
extraction.evidence_quote: Discarding a path under a symlinked parent deletes files OUTSIDE the worktree via the rm fallback — data loss beyond the repository.
test_ideas: 建立临时 Git 仓库和仓库外目录，在仓库中创建指向外部目录的符号链接；分别调用单文件和批量丢弃操作，验证链接下的目标路径被拒绝且外部文件内容保持不变。
针对符号链接目录下不存在的叶子路径执行丢弃，验证不会删除外部父目录或其他文件。

pulls.title: Guard untracked discard against symlink escapes
pulls.body:
## Summary
- add a discard target safety check that resolves real worktree boundaries before untracked cleanup
- use `git clean -ffdx -- <path>` for local and SSH relay untracked discard cleanup after validation
- add regression coverage for symlinked parent paths, bulk discard atomicity, root-target rejection, symlink-leaf discard behavior, ignored paths, and nested repo targets

Fixes #2928

## Validation
- `pnpm exec vitest run --config config/vitest.config.ts src/shared/git-discard-path-safety.test.ts src/main/git/status.test.ts src/main/git/status-discard-symlink.test.ts src/relay/git-handler.test.ts`
- `pnpm run tc`
- `pnpm run lint`
- `git diff --check`
- adversarial Git cleanup probes for symlinked parents, ignored targets, and nested repo targets

extraction.symptom: 升级失败后的自动回滚清空了未提交的用户故事文件，并留下部分升级状态。
extraction.root_cause: 正文将原因描述为三个可能根因：更新引用发布树中不存在的路径，安全检查把用户层文件当作系统层文件，回滚恢复上游版本而备份仅保存已提交 HEAD、未保存更新前工作树内容；这些判断未获补丁核验。

pulls.title: fix(updater): git-safety on abort + preserve user files on safety-violation rollback (#915)
pulls.body:
Salvages the two updater-safety fixes from @lavkeshdwivedi's #1061 and #1066 onto a clean `main`, extracted from a swarm branch that was stacked on an unrelated large feature. **Commit authorship is preserved to @lavkeshdwivedi** (cherry-picked, not rewritten).

**From #1066 — three git-safety bugs in `update-system.mjs` (closes #915):**
1. `revertPaths()` ran `git checkout -- <path>`, a no-op after `apply()` already staged new content via `git checkout FETCH_HEAD -- <path>` → on abort, system files stayed staged at the new version. Now `git checkout HEAD -- <path>` (resets index+worktree to the pre-update commit), with a `cat-file -e` existence probe + `git rm` fallback for paths absent from HEAD (re-throws non-existence errors instead of blind-deleting).
2. `apply()` and `rollback()` ran bare `git commit -m` (no pathspec), sweeping unrelated pre-staged files into the update/rollback commit → now scoped to `-- <pathsToStage>` / `-- <rollbackPaths>`.
3. Backup branch only captured committed HEAD → added a `git stash create` WIP snapshot under `refs/backup-pre-update-wip/<version>` with a recovery hint (non-fatal).

**From #1061 — preserve user files on safety-violation rollback (refs #995, partial):**
- The safety-violation rollback path called `revertPaths([...updated, ...violatedUserPaths])`, and `revertPaths` does `git checkout -- <paths>` → it overwrote the user's *uncommitted* working-tree content (e.g. `interview-prep/story-bank.md`) with the upstream stub. Now reverts only system-layer `updated` and leaves user files untouched, printing a "your content was NOT overwritten" diagnostic for each.

pulls.body:
## Summary

Closes #915.

Three related bugs in `update-system.mjs` that can silently lose uncommitted edits or leave the repo half-applied when an update aborts:

---

### Bug 1 — `revertPaths()` was a no-op on staged files (half-applied repo)

`apply()` stages new content with `git checkout FETCH_HEAD -- <path>`, so the **index already holds the new version**. The old `revertPaths()` ran `git checkout -- <path>` (restores worktree from index), which is a complete no-op when the index and worktree are already identical. On abort, system files were left **staged at the new version** instead of being rolled back.

**Fix:** `revertPaths()` now runs `git checkout HEAD -- <path>`, which resets both the index and worktree from the HEAD commit (pre-update state). For paths that don't exist in HEAD (newly introduced by the update), the path is removed via `git rm` + `rmSync`.

---

### Bug 2 — Bare `git commit` swept unrelated staged files

`apply()` and `rollback()` both ran `git commit -m <msg>` with **no pathspec**, committing the entire staging area. If another session had pre-staged an unrelated file, it got swept into the update/rollback commit silently.

**Fix:** Both `git commit` calls now receive `-- ...paths` to scope the commit to exactly the files the update/rollback touched.

---

### Bug 3 — Backup branch captured only committed state

`git branch backup-pre-update-<version>` points to HEAD. **Uncommitted edits are not in HEAD** and were lost if the update or its rollback discarded them.

**Fix:** Before branching, `git stash create` builds a stash object (without modifying the stash stack) and its sha is saved under `refs/backup-pre-update-wip/<version>`. Recovery: `git stash apply refs/backup-pre-update-wip/<version>`.

---

## Test plan

- [x] 4 new source-level pattern assertions added to `updater-migration-tests.mjs` — all pass (`55 passed, 0 failed`)
- [x] Existing migration tests still pass

**Manual verification (bug 1):**
1. Make an uncommitted edit to any system file
2. Run `node update-system.mjs apply` (or simulate an abort by tripping the safety check)
3. **Before:** system files left staged at new version. **After:** files reverted to HEAD

**Manual verification (bug 3):**
1. Make an uncommitted edit before updating
2. Inspect `git for-each-ref refs/backup-pre-update-wip/` after update starts — the WIP ref should appear

pulls.body:
## Summary

When `apply()` detected a user-layer file in the post-update diff, it called:

```js
revertPaths([...updated, ...violatedUserPaths])
```

Including `violatedUserPaths` caused `git checkout -- <user-file>` to restore HEAD content, **overwriting the user's uncommitted working-tree content** (e.g. accumulated STAR+R stories in `interview-prep/story-bank.md`) with the upstream stub. The backup branch only captures committed HEAD, so the content was irrecoverable — exactly the data loss reported in #995.

**Fix:** only revert `updated` (the system-layer paths that were checked out). The user files are left exactly as they were before the abort. A per-file diagnostic message lists each affected path so the user can inspect and clean up manually.

## Before / after

**Before** — rollback on safety violation:
```
revertPaths([...updated, ...violatedUserPaths])
```
→ user content overwritten by `git checkout --`

**After** — rollback on safety violation:
```
revertPaths([...updated])
// violatedUserPaths printed as diagnostics, left untouched
```
→ user content preserved

## Test plan

- [ ] `node --check update-system.mjs` passes
- [ ] Simulate a safety violation: set up a repo where a user file (e.g. `portals.yml`) is unexpectedly in the diff after checkout, then confirm `apply()` reverts system paths but leaves the user file content intact
- [ ] Confirm the diagnostic message lists the user file path after abort

Closes #995

environment: 同时传入 src 和 tests 搜索路径
extraction.evidence_quote:
6. `rg "this" src/ tests/` => **`src/invalid` is found**
7. `rg "this" tests/ src/` => funnily, `src/invalid` is not found
test_ideas: 按正文建立 src、tests 和被 .gitignore 排除的 src/invalid，比较无路径、单路径及两种多路径排列的搜索结果，验证忽略文件始终不出现。
对相同目录集合枚举参数排列，比较归一化后的结果集合，验证搜索语义不依赖参数顺序。
分别使用带尾斜杠和不带尾斜杠的目录参数执行同一搜索，检查忽略规则是否一致。

pulls.title: fix(ignore): respect .gitignore with multiple search paths
pulls.body:
## Summary

When ripgrep is given multiple search paths (e.g. `rg pattern src/ tests/`), compiled parent-directory ignore matchers were cached keyed only by the parent directory path. Reusing those entries for later search roots could leave a stale `absolute_base`, causing `.gitignore` rules to be applied incorrectly.

This change keys the cache by `(parent_path, absolute_base_path)` and adds a regression test reproducing the order-dependent behavior from the issue.

Fixes #3376

Related: #3320

## Test plan

- [x] `cargo test -p ignore multi_root_gitignore_absolute_base`
- [x] `cargo test -p ignore`

pulls.title: fix(workday): key the cap-hit warning on entry provenance, not on --since
pulls.body:
## What does this PR do?

`providers/workday.mjs` picked between its two cap-hit warnings by testing `sinceMs === null`. That was a proxy for the real question — *"does this caller have a `portals.yml` `tracked_companies` entry the user could edit?"* — and since #2418 the proxy no longer holds, so a `scan.mjs --since` run loses the `raise max_pages on this entry for more` advice on a tracked company. This states provenance explicitly instead of inferring it: `scan-ats-full.mjs` sets `ctx.syntheticEntries`, and the message is keyed on that.

## Related issue

Fixes #2495

## Reproducing it

Driving `workday.fetch()` directly with a mock transport, one `tracked_companies` entry with `max_pages: 3`, `total: 200`, every posting `Posted Today` (so the `--since` early-stop never pre-empts the cap). The **only** difference between the two runs is `ctx.sinceMs`:

| run | warning | actionable? |
|---|---|---|
| `node scan.mjs` (`sinceMs = null`) | `⚠️  workday: AcmeCorp truncated at max_pages=3 (60 of 200 jobs) — raise max_pages on this entry for more` | ✅ |
| `node scan.mjs --since 7d` (`sinceMs = now-7d`) | `⚠️  workday: AcmeCorp truncated at 3 pages (60 of 200 jobs)` | ❌ |

After this change both runs emit the first line, and a reverse scan still gets the second.

You mentioned on the issue that you don't mark anything `confirmed` until you've reproduced the exact branch — this is a provider-level reproduction against a mock transport, not a live tenant, so it pins the branch rather than the field report. Happy to adjust if you'd rather see it framed differently.

## Why the change touches a second file

`workday.mjs` on its own can only *infer* provenance, which is the bug. The one caller that both synthesizes entries and can reach the cap has to say so — `scan-ats-full.mjs` is a one-line `ctx` addition. `discover-ats.mjs` and `verify-portals.mjs` also call `workday.fetch()` with synthesized/tracked entries, but both probe with `ctx.maxPages: 1`, which never sets `stopReason` to `'cap'`, so neither needs to opt in. Absence of the flag therefore means "tracked", which keeps the next caller that starts setting `sinceMs` from re-coupling the two concerns — the shape you and @LayerC0de both landed on in the issue.

## Before / after

```diff
-    if (sinceMs === null) {
+    const syntheticEntries = ctx?.syntheticEntries === true;
+    if (!syntheticEntries) {
```

Both message strings are unchanged; only the condition selecting between them moved. The `(total may be Workday-capped, not real)` tag is about the tenant's `total`, not about provenance, so it stays on the terse line — pinned by a test so the rekey can't quietly drop it.

## Tests

Four assertions in `tests/providers/workday.test.mjs`, pinning which warning fires for which caller:

- a full `scan.mjs` run gets the advice
- a `scan.mjs --since` run **keeps** the advice ← fails on `main`, passes here
- a reverse scan (synthesized entries) stays terse, no advice
- the Workday-capped-total tag survives on the reverse-scan line

Three existing tests encoded the old proxy (they simulated "reverse-scan context" with `sinceMs` alone); they now declare `syntheticEntries: true`, which is what they were always describing in their comments.

`node test-all.mjs`: **3434 passed, 0 failed** (3430 on `main` — the +4 are the new assertions). The single warning is the pre-existing `cv-sync-check.mjs exited with error (expected without user data)`, present on `main` too.

- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Documentation / translation
- [ ] Refactor (no behavior change)

- [x] I have read [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/santifer/career-ops/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)

pulls.title: fix(cli): exit instead of aborting when stdout cannot be written
pulls.body:
## Summary

- `main()` resets SIGPIPE so a closed pipe exits quietly instead of panicking into SIGABRT under `panic = "abort"` (#1004). Every **other** write failure still panics inside `std` and aborts with a core dump — a full disk, an exhausted tmpfs quota, an I/O error.
- Catches that one panic (`failed printing to std…`), reports it on stderr and exits non-zero, delegating every other panic to the default hook. One guard in `main()` rather than touching ~1100 `println!` call sites, which return no error to handle.
- Adds a regression test using `/dev/full`.

Seen in the field: on a machine whose `/tmp` is a tmpfs with a per-user quota, the quota filled while a tool had rtk's stdout pointed at a file there. 21 rtk processes aborted in 33 minutes, every one at the same address, each leaving a core dump:

```
thread 'main' panicked at library/std/src/io/stdio.rs:1166:9:
failed printing to stdout: Quota exceeded (os error 122)
```

Every subcommand was affected — `read`, `ls`, `df`, `grep`, `ssh` — because the work had already completed and only the printing failed. The output was lost and the caller saw a crash instead of a result.

```
$ rtk read Cargo.toml > /dev/full
before:  Aborted (core dumped)   exit 134, core dumped
after:   rtk: failed printing to stdout: No space left on device (os error 28)
         exit 1, no core dump
```

## Test plan

- [x] `cargo fmt --all && cargo clippy --all-targets && cargo test` — fmt clean, clippy 0 warnings, **3809 passed / 0 failed**
- [x] Manual testing: `rtk read Cargo.toml > /dev/full` → exit 1 with a stderr line, no core dump (release profile, `panic = "abort"`)
- [x] Broken pipe unchanged: `rtk read Cargo.toml | head -1` still exits cleanly
- [x] Regression test verified to **fail without the fix** (exit 101 in debug, 134 in release) and pass with it

Note: `test_broken_pipe_does_not_crash` and the new test both spawn `target/debug/rtk`, so they can pass against a stale binary if `cargo build` failed — worth knowing when running them.

extraction.symptom: Windows 上启动窗口延迟约十秒至数分钟出现，或在显示后疑似崩溃。
extraction.root_cause: 正文报告：用于探测 CLI agent 的串行 where.exe 子进程被应用控制软件要求交互审批，后台审批无法显示或关闭，导致主进程启动阻塞；崩溃原因未明确证实。
extraction.root_cause_category: 子进程探测与启动阻塞
environment: 对 where.exe 启用交互审批的企业权限管理或应用控制软件
启动时探测 25–30+ 个 CLI agent
extraction.evidence_quote: Orca crashes or hangs for up to ~5 minutes on startup when a corporate privilege-management / application-control tool gates the `where.exe` calls Orca uses for agent detection.
test_ideas: 在 Windows 测试环境中拦截 where.exe 并保持审批待处理，记录启动到窗口显示的耗时，检查是否能在规定启动时限内显示界面。
分别模拟单个探测阻塞和多个探测阻塞，检查启动等待是否随候选数量累积。
对比审批立即通过、延迟通过和持续待处理的启动结果，记录进程退出状态及日志，区分启动缓慢与实际崩溃。

pulls.body:
## ELI5

An old launcher for GitHub's command can hide a working installation behind it. Orca now finds the working copy and keeps using it, so Settings can show the integration as connected.

## What Changed

Before, an executable `gh` launcher that exits 126 made the GitHub card say **Not installed**; Re-check tried that launcher again. After, Orca tries working copies in PATH order, then its existing install directories, and uses the successful copy for version, authentication, and native GitHub/GitLab operations. On macOS/Linux this follows the matching PATH context; on Windows it applies only in the preflight working directory. Windows requests from a different repo directory retain normal lookup and may still run the broken launcher.

This extends the existing filesystem resolver. Recovery runs at most four distinct `--version` probes within one five-second subprocess budget; timeout ends the search. Explicit executable paths retain their selection. Windows batch files use the existing safe process runner. Native operations reuse the proven selection only while PATH, home, relevant working directory, and the selected file still match; authentication and user operations never switch copies on failure. Re-check keeps a valid matching copy available while version probes run; only the newest completed check can replace it or clear a failed selection.

## Why

Keeping PATH order preserves working version-manager installations. Trying another copy recovers this reported case without asking users to remove old folders or introducing new settings or status fields. Sharing selection with native operations also fixes the review finding where a connected card still ran the broken launcher during an actual request.

Credit: this updates Aashish Mahato's (@aashish254) original PR rather than opening a competing fix. His original implementation commit remains authored by Aashish; the additional bounds, Windows handling, regression coverage, and native selection handoff are separate maintainer commits.

## Linked Issue

Fixes #22975

## Visual Proof

Hidden Electron screenshots of **Settings → Integrations**, with disposable homes/profiles and an executable failing launcher before a working fixture. The same renderer shows **Not installed** before and **Connected** after; baseline Re-check also remained stuck. Authentication is a local fixture, with no real GitHub request. These screenshots show cold-start recovery; the later refresh correction is verified by concurrent real native provider calls.

Before:

![GitHub card says Not installed despite a working copy behind the failing shim](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/26c8b57b-ba00-426d-bb72-64be06f45a30)

After:

![GitHub card says Connected using the recovered working copy](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/d6b02882-cb64-49ec-97e0-8d18e0104e63)

## Testing

- [x] I manually tested these changes locally
- [x] Automated tests added/updated

On macOS, independently reproduced the original production failure before edits: `onPath=true`, `available=false`, first copy exits **126**, absolute second copy exits **0**. The same behavioral assertion fails before and passes after. Also reproduced production native `gh` and `glab` operations failing after successful version/auth, then verified both operations succeed with the shared selection.

Scoped validation: **242 passed, 23 platform skips** across 23 files, including resolver/preflight, actual native provider processes, account binding, host selection, rate limits, abort/deadline handling, child-process boundaries, and unchanged WSL/SSH controls. The provider suite includes three regressions that genuinely failed before the concurrent-refresh correction and pass after, alongside the Windows-only cases skipped on macOS. `pnpm tc:node`, formatting, changed-code-quality, and `git diff --check` pass.

Reproduce the primary regression:

```sh
ORCA_BACKGROUND_LAUNCH=1 pnpm test src/main/ipc/preflight-runnable-local-cli.test.ts src/main/ipc/preflight-provider-command-selection.test.ts src/main/ipc/preflight-host-cli-status.test.ts
```

Cases cover ordered selection, all failing, missing, directories, non-executable files, relative/explicit paths, duplicate entries, the four-copy limit, a real timeout, install-directory recovery, custom PATH, changed/removed selections, concurrent probes/requests during refresh, definitive failed refresh, and no fallback after auth or operation failures. Windows-only `.cmd` regressions are included; real Windows/Linux execution awaits this head's CI.

## AI Disclosure

## Review

Independent read-only review is clean at `9639aca48dc7ac2fb8797471d890be45caf1c5b2`. The reviewer authored a durable report binding all 13 paths to the exact commit, tree and old/new content blobs, and independently verified actual GitHub/GitLab calls before, during and after refresh. The earlier native-operation and refresh-race findings are closed. This source verdict explicitly excludes Windows calls from a different working directory; real subprocess review ran on macOS. Exact published-head CI is pending; old-head bot reviews are not claimed as fresh.

- [x] Not applicable; no upstream agent skill or installer source copied.

Windows selections are reused only in the preflight working directory, preserving its current-directory-first lookup rule; repo-directory calls bypass that stored selection. pulls.body:
## Summary

Adds IBM Bob (Bob Shell) as a first-class TUI agent: catalog entry, PATH detection, launch through `--prompt-interactive`, foreground process recognition, and a one-shot command filter so headless runs are not mistaken for a live session. Closes #7691.

Bob ships opt-in rather than on by default. `bob` is also the binary name of the Neovim version manager, and Orca detection is a bare PATH lookup, so anyone holding that tool would otherwise see IBM Bob listed as installed and get a dead pane on launch. It is seeded into `DEFAULT_DISABLED_TUI_AGENTS` with a one-shot `bobDefaultDisabledMigrated` guard so existing profiles start hidden too, and is turned on from Agent settings. For the same reason it sits in the tail of the auto-pick order rather than the head. IBM ships no alias binary to detect on instead: the package `bin` map is `{ "bob": "bundle/bob.js" }`, and the package is not on the public registry.

The flag contract is verified against Bob Shell 1.0.6 itself rather than the docs alone. `bob --help` plus the yargs option table in the shipped bundle show `--auth-method`, `--extensions`/`-e`, `--fake-responses` and `--record-responses` taking values while hidden from help output, and `t.strict()` is on, so an unrecognized flag fails the run outright.

- `types.ts` / `tui-agent-config.ts`: register `bob` with `promptInjectionMode: 'flag-prompt-interactive'`. `--prompt` and positional prompts are one-shot; `--prompt-interactive` runs the initial prompt and keeps the shell alive.
- `bob-headless-command.ts`: one value-aware token pass that stops at `--`, skips option values, and reuses `optionName` from `print-mode-headless-command.ts` instead of forking it.
- `agent-process-recognition.ts`: Bob is a node script, so `node .../node_modules/bobshell/bundle/bob.js` resolves through `NODE_PACKAGE_SCRIPT_ENTRYPOINTS`, same as codex and gemini.
- `tui-agent-permissions.ts`: the yolo profile uses Bob's own `-y, --yolo`.
- Standard registrations: agent-kind, telemetry-events, agent-status-types, agent-type-label, tui-agent-display-names, skills-cli-agent-keys (`null`, the skills CLI has no Bob key), desktop and mobile catalogs, a bundled 64px icon for the mobile offline-icon invariant, and the `IBM Bob` label in all five locale catalogs.

Deliberately out of scope for this PR: session resume, agent status hooks, AI vault, source-control AI, and trust presets. That matches how Ante and Trae landed.

## Screenshots

No visual change beyond Bob appearing in the existing agent lists once it is enabled in Agent settings.

## Testing

- [x] `pnpm lint`
- [x] `pnpm typecheck` (plus `typecheck` in `mobile/`)
- [x] `pnpm test` (3983 files, 42064 passed, 73 skipped)
- [x] `pnpm build`
- [x] Added or updated high-quality tests that would catch regressions
- [x] `vitest run` in `mobile/` (57 files, 384 passed)

Tests added or updated: Bob process recognition including the hidden value-taking options, the `--` terminator, management subcommands, the node-bundle entrypoint form and the `--yolo --prompt-interactive` launch line; the yolo permission profile; the opt-in default and its one-shot migration in `persistence.test.ts`, covering both the first migrated load and a later explicit opt-in.

Manual smoke tests against a real Bob Shell 1.0.6 install:

- `bob --prompt-interactive "Do not edit files. Reply READY only, then wait for my next message."` ran the initial prompt, replied `READY`, and stayed in the interactive follow-up UI.
- `bob --prompt "Reply READY only"` printed Bob's deprecation warning for `--prompt` and completed as a one-shot command.
- `bob "Reply READY only"` completed as a one-shot command.

Not yet verified: a fresh install and an expired session inside an Orca PTY, including the `bob.ibm.com/login` browser handoff. I will post that separately.

## AI Review Report

- Cross-platform: recognition normalizes `bob`, `bob.cmd` and the `node .../bob.js` bundle form with no hardcoded path separators; detection and launch go through the shared TUI agent config on macOS, Linux and Windows.
- SSH and remote: Bob uses the shared preflight detection path, so remote hosts receive the same command shape as every other agent. No local-only assumptions were added.
- Agent contract: every flag the classifier treats as value-taking was checked against the 1.0.6 option table rather than the published docs, after the docs turned out to omit four of them.
- Settings: the opt-in default needed the one-shot migration flag, otherwise it would only apply to fresh profiles while existing profiles kept Bob visible, and re-applying it on every load would prevent the toggle from sticking.
- Performance: the classifier is a bounded token scan on paths that already tokenize the command line. Detection adds one PATH probe and no subprocess, keeping the zero-subprocess detection invariant intact.
- UI: no new primitives. Desktop and mobile catalogs reuse the existing label and icon paths.

## Security Audit

- Command execution: no new spawn path. Launch goes through the shared agent startup builder, which shell-quotes the prompt the same way it does for every other agent.
- Permissions: `--yolo` is only appended when the user selects the yolo profile, and Bob is disabled by default, so nothing auto-approves tools without two explicit user actions.
- Secrets: Orca stores no Bob credentials. Authentication stays inside Bob, which uses its own browser SSO or `BOBSHELL_API_KEY`; neither is read or persisted here.
- Input handling: the one-shot classifier is pure string inspection with no filesystem or network access, and the detection probe is a PATH existence check.
- Dependencies: none added.

## Notes

- Rebased onto main; the branch was well behind.
- The opt-in default touches global settings and adds a persistence migration, which is wider than plain agent registration. Happy to drop back to the auto-pick reorder alone if maintainers would rather keep this PR to registration.

## Summary

All five conflicts are the *same* conflict, replicated once per locale. It is the
textbook additive collision that `CLAUDE.md` predicts for this fork:

> Чаще всего конфликтуют файлы локалей (`src/renderer/src/i18n/locales/*.json`) и `pnpm-lock.yaml`.

Both sides appended new keys to the tail of the **same** JSON object —
`auto.components.right.sidebar.SourceControl` — so git had two competing
"last lines" for one region and could not interleave them. There is no semantic
overlap: the two sides add disjoint keys serving unrelated features.

---

The conflict is byte-identical in structure across `en`, `es`, `ja`, `ko`, `zh`
(only the translated values differ), so they are documented together rather than
repeated five times. Conflict location:

- `createPrIntentSyncing` — e.g. `"Syncing branch…"`
- `createPrIntentSyncConflicts` — e.g. `"Sync hit conflicts. Resolve them, then retry Create PR."`

English fallthrough). These sit alongside the pre-existing
`createPrIntentCommitBlockedSummary`, so they are a coherent extension of an
upstream feature the fork does not touch.

### What the fork changed

Added two hash-keyed strings, both with the value `"Canvas"`:

- `5c951f3e68`
- `897d7c622d`

Introduced by fork commit `587205e07` — _"i18n: add strings for canvas notes,
canvas issues and the mermaid chip"_. Both are live and consumed by
`src/renderer/src/components/right-sidebar/SourceControl.tsx`:

- `SourceControl.tsx:7363` → `translate('auto.components.right.sidebar.SourceControl.5c951f3e68', 'Canvas')`

Purely positional. Both sides appended to the tail of the same object with no

pulls.title: fix(exec): survive closed child pipes under --auto; strip DeepSeek DSML in one-shot exec
pulls.body:
Two dogfood bugs in `codewhale exec`.

## (a) `exec --auto` exits 141 with no output

**Root cause.** `crates/cli/src/main.rs` and `codewhale-tui`'s `run_with_args` reset SIGPIPE to `SIG_DFL` so `codewhale doctor | head` exits quietly (#4030). The interactive TUI re-ignores SIGPIPE (`event_loop.rs`) because it writes to pipes it does not own. Headless `exec` never did. So any write to a child that had closed its end (a stdio MCP server, hook, or LSP) killed the whole process with SIGPIPE before it printed anything. 0.10.0 has the same bug.

**Fix.** `run_exec_agent` ignores SIGPIPE for the run. The failed write now surfaces as `EPIPE` on that one pipe. Children still start with `SIG_DFL`, because std resets it before exec. Every exec stdout write (text, `--json`, stream-json) goes through `write_exec_stdout`, which turns a `BrokenPipe` on stdout into the same quiet 141 exit. So `exec ... | head` behaves as it did before.

## (b) one-shot `exec` prints raw DeepSeek DSML

**Root cause.** Plain `exec` offers no tools, but DeepSeek still answers with a tool call written as text, in a doubled-delimiter DSML form (`<｜｜DSML｜｜ calls>` / `<｜｜DSML｜｜ invoke …>`) that the stream filter did not recognize. The filter had a second problem: while inside a block, it accepted *any* end marker when its own closer was not in the current delta. A nested `</…invoke>` split across deltas therefore ended the block early and leaked the rest. Once the markup was stripped, the answer was empty or whitespace. The engine then re-requested (the reasoning-only and empty-stop retries), got the same call back, and ended on a misleading "provider response was incomplete".

**Fix.**
- Add the doubled-delimiter pairs to the marker tables.
- An open block now closes only on its own end marker.
- In a zero-tool turn, an answer that was only a stripped tool call is not persisted and is not retried. The turn fails once with "Model answered only with a tool call, and this turn offers no tools."
- `exec` prints a stderr notice pointing at `--auto` / `--allowed-tools`.

## Evidence

Real runs against the configured DeepSeek route on this machine:

```
$ codewhale exec --auto "say hi"; echo exit=$?          # installed 0.10.0
exit=141                                                  # no stdout, no stderr, 0.55s
$ target/debug/codewhale exec --auto "say hi"; echo exit=$?   # this branch
Hi.

What do you need?
exit=0

$ codewhale exec "List the files in the current directory."   # 0.10.0
<｜｜DSML｜｜ calls>
<｜｜DSML｜｜ invoke name="bash">
<｜｜DSML｜｜ parameter name="command" string="true">ls -la /private/tmp</｜｜DSML｜｜ parameter>
</｜｜DSML｜｜ invoke>
</｜｜DSML｜｜ calls>
exit=0
$ target/debug/codewhale exec "List the files in the current directory."   # this branch
codewhale exec: the model tried to call a tool, but this run offers none, so the tool call was removed from the answer. Re-run with --auto (or --allowed-tools) to let it use tools.

error: Model answered only with a tool call, and this turn offers no tools.
error: exec turn failed: Model answered only with a tool call, and this turn offers no tools.
exit=1

$ target/debug/codewhale exec "say hi" | head -c 1; echo " pipe-exit=${pipestatus[1]}"
H pipe-exit=141
```

Before the zero-tool fail-fast, the same one-shot run re-requested 3–4 times and ended on `Model returned reasoning but no answer or tool call; the provider response was incomplete`.

## Tests

Focused runs of `scripts/dev-cargo.sh test -p codewhale-tui --locked --lib --test integration -- …`:
- Lib: 17 passed, 0 failed (filter_tool_scenario incl. the new all-cut-points DSML case, marker_tables_are_consistent, reasoning_only_*), plus 6 passed, 0 failed (empty_clean_stop_*, tool_result_followed_by_terminal_empty_assistant_fails_turn, fake_wrapper_notice_*).
- Integration: 8 passed, 0 failed (`exec_turn_usage::*`, including the new `exec_auto_survives_an_mcp_server_that_closes_its_stdin` and `one_shot_exec_strips_deepseek_dsml_and_points_at_auto`), plus 5 passed, 0 failed (`protocol_recovery` fake-wrapper tests).
- `exec_auto_survives_an_mcp_server_that_closes_its_stdin` **fails** with the SIGPIPE ignore removed. The DSML integration test failed against the earlier strip-only version, which exited 0 on a blank line.

Gates run locally, all passing:
- `sync-changelog.sh`
- web `derive-changelog` / `derive-facts` / `derive-install`
- `check-versions.sh --range-audit-advisory`
- `check-contributor-credit.py v0.10.0`
- `vitest lib/public-copy.test.ts` (6/6)
- `check-blocking-calls-budget.py`
- `check-dead-code-budget.py`
- `check-runtime-contract-budget.py` (55 metrics at budget)
- `split/module_graph.py --check`
- `cargo fmt --check`

The full suite and clippy are left to CI.

No-Issue: dogfood bugs found during 0.10.1 ship work (exec --auto exit 141, raw DSML in one-shot exec); tracked under the v0.10.1 milestone.

pulls.title: fix(cli): reset SIGPIPE to SIG_DFL so piped output exits cleanly
pulls.body:
Resolves #4030.

## Problem

When codewhale output is piped into a command that exits early (e.g. `codewhale doctor | head`), the process panics instead of terminating cleanly:

```
Process panicked
Location: std::io::stdio.rs:1165:9
Panic: failed printing to stdout: Broken pipe (os error 32)
```

Crash dumps appear in `~/.deepseek/crashes/`.

## Root cause

Many execution environments (systemd, Docker, some shells) inherit SIGPIPE set to `SIG_IGN`. When SIGPIPE is ignored, `write(2)` returns `EPIPE` instead of delivering the signal, and Rust's `println!` treats any `std::io::Error` from `write_all` as fatal and panics. (Diagnosis and proposed fix come from the issue itself — thanks @BrathonBai.)

## Fix

Reset SIGPIPE to `SIG_DFL` in `main()` before any output, so the process gets the standard Unix clean exit (code 141) on a broken pipe. Windows has no SIGPIPE and is excluded via `#[cfg(unix)]`.

```rust
#[cfg(unix)]
unsafe {
    libc::signal(libc::SIGPIPE, libc::SIG_DFL);
}
```

The `libc` dependency in `crates/cli/Cargo.toml` was previously scoped to `cfg(linux)` (for the `PR_SET_PDEATHSIG` parent-death cleanup in #3259); it is now `cfg(unix)` so the SIGPIPE reset works on macOS/BSD too. The Linux-only `PR_SET_PDEATHSIG` code path is unchanged.

## Verification

```
cargo build -p codewhale-cli     # ok
cargo fmt --check                 # clean
cargo clippy -p codewhale-cli     # clean
```

Reproduces the issue before the fix (`codewhale doctor | head` → panic); after the fix the process exits cleanly on the broken pipe.

pulls.body:
## TLDR

Fixes Gemini CLI hanging indefinitely when executed from Node.js `child_process` (subprocess) by adding intelligent stdin state detection to `readStdin()`. The fix preserves the ability to combine `-p` flag with stdin input while preventing infinite waits in subprocess environments.

## Dive Deeper

This addresses a critical regression introduced in v0.1.22 where the CLI would hang indefinitely when spawned as a Node.js subprocess. The root cause was that `readStdin()` would unconditionally wait for stdin input in non-TTY environments, but subprocess stdin streams aren't properly closed by default, causing infinite blocking.

**Key improvements to `readStdin()`:**
- **Initial state detection**: Checks if stdin is already ended/destroyed before waiting
- **Non-blocking data check**: Uses `process.stdin.read()` to detect immediately available data
- **Smart timeout mechanism**: Only applies 50ms timeout when no data has been received; once data starts flowing, waits normally for complete input
- **Subprocess detection**: Identifies when stdin is not readable (typical subprocess scenario)

This solution maintains backward compatibility with:
- Terminal usage (direct CLI execution)
- Pipe operations (`echo "data" | gemini -p "prompt"`)
- Combined stdin + `-p` flag usage (introduced in PR #4406)

## Reviewer Test Plan

**Quick validation:**
```bash
# Build the project
npm run build

# Test subprocess execution (should complete quickly, not hang)
node -e "
const { spawn } = require('child_process');
const child = spawn('node', ['packages/cli/dist/src/gemini.js', '-y', '-m', 'gemini-2.5-flash', '-p', 'hello']);
child.stdin.end();
child.on('close', (code) => console.log('Exit code:', code));
setTimeout(() => { child.kill(); console.log('TIMEOUT - Fix failed!'); }, 5000);
"

# Test normal stdin functionality still works
echo "context data" | node packages/cli/dist/src/gemini.js -y -m gemini-2.5-flash -p "analyze this"
```

**Expected results:**
- Subprocess test completes in <1 second with exit code 0
- Stdin + prompt combination works normally

## Testing Matrix

|          | 🍏  | 🪟  | 🐧  |
| -------- | --- | --- | --- |
| npm run  | ✅  | ❓  | ❓  |

## Linked issues / bugs

## Problem
Fixes #159

`agent-reach doctor` falsely reported XiaoHongShu MCP connection failure on Windows with mcporter 0.7.3, even when the MCP server was running and usable.

## Root cause
The health-check used a rigid string match `'"status": "ok"' in out` on the lowercased `mcporter list` JSON output. On Windows, PowerShell can prepend a UTF-8 BOM, use CRLF line endings, or emit slightly different whitespace — all of which break the literal string comparison.

Additionally, the default 5 s / 10 s timeouts are too tight for mcporter on Windows.

## Changes
- **`_mcporter_status_ok()`** (new helper): parses the output with `json.loads()` first; strips UTF-8 BOM before parsing; falls back to normalised (BOM/CRLF/space-stripped) string search for backward compatibility.
- **Windows timeouts**: `config get` 5 s → 15 s; `list` 10 s → 30 s. Unchanged on Linux/macOS.

## Testing
- All 49 existing tests pass (`pytest tests/ -x -q`)
- Verified `_mcporter_status_ok()` handles: normal JSON, BOM-prefixed JSON, CRLF output, space-stripped JSON, case variants — all correctly.

preconditions: 在支持目录链接的 macOS、Linux 或 Windows 隔离环境生成合法项目计划；Windows 创建链接所需权限已具备。
根外目录包含同名产物和哨兵文件，保存内容快照。
steps: 生成计划后移走候选父目录，在原位置建立指向根外目录的链接，使候选末级路径仍可解析。
分别执行计划预演和真实清理，检查拒绝信息及文件快照。
使用独立夹具将扫描根本身替换为外部目录链接，再重放计划。
cases.expected_result: 父目录链逃逸和根路径形态变化均被拒绝，不沿链接清理外部同名产物；外部文件、移走的原项目及替代目录内容不变。错误能够定位相关路径或根边界。
cases.rationale: 历史报告提供父目录符号链接导致删除越界的触发线索，所给 PR 补丁也包含父链接拒绝断言；不据交叉引用认定修复关系，不迁移 Git 丢弃功能、末级链接删除策略或批量原子性。
cases.incremental_value: 补充父目录链及扫描根替换，现有目标产品测试主要替换候选末级目录。

existing_tests.reason: 触发条件为候选末级目录换成链接，断言重验证失败；未替换父目录或扫描根，也没有实际清理后的内容断言。

cases.title: 混合恢复批次不覆盖用户目标，拒绝链接且失败后继续
preconditions: 隔离 graveyard 有可恢复项、已有用户目标项、父目录链接指向外部的项。
保存 payload、manifest、已有目标及外部文件内容，提供受控 TTY。
steps: 执行交互 restore --dry-run，核对 newest-first 顺序，用编号和范围选择混合批次并确认。
比较快照及缺失目标父目录。
执行真实交互 restore，用 all 选择并确认。
核对成功项内容、拒绝项 payload、统计和退出码。
cases.expected_result: 预演不移动 payload、不创建目标目录、不更新 manifest。真实恢复不覆盖已有用户内容、不沿链接写入外部目录；拒绝项不妨碍可恢复项继续处理。restored/skipped/failed 总数与结果一致，有任何项未恢复则非零退出。
cases.rationale: 迁移历史报告中已有用户内容被恢复操作覆盖的触发条件；不迁移升级功能或将提炼的可能根因写成事实。批次与预演断言来自 PRD。
cases.incremental_value: 补充交互混合批次、用户内容逐字保留、父链接、失败继续和汇总退出码。

existing_tests.reason: 该唯一调用片段位于重新创建原目标目录的测试中，覆盖直接恢复拒绝已有目标；没有用户内容保留或批次继续断言。
覆盖直接 ID 恢复预演、目标父目录不创建和 manifest 不变；不覆盖交互混合批次及链接目标。

cases.category: 忽略作用域与错误契约
cases.title: 父目录排除后的深层重新包含及命令行覆盖
preconditions: 单一扫描根包含多个子项目；根 .rcleanignore 排除 legacy-monorepo/，再重新包含 important-app/node_modules。
另备非法 .rcleanignore 和非法 --ignore 的独立夹具。
steps: 扫描共同根，核对深层重新包含路径及其他排除路径。
叠加匹配重新包含路径的 --ignore，重新扫描。
分别使用非法忽略文件和非法命令行 glob 扫描，记录告警和退出状态。
cases.expected_result: 深层重新包含符合 PRD 示例；命令行忽略仍可排除被文件重新包含的路径。非法 --ignore 使扫描失败；非法 .rcleanignore 告警后继续报告合法候选，并标明结果可能不完整。
cases.rationale: 历史案例提示扫描入口变化可能影响忽略作用域；仅迁移作用域边界到明确支持的单根嵌套项目。所给 ripgrep PR 未合并，其多根测试不构成 rclean 覆盖或多位置参数支持依据。
cases.incremental_value: 新增整个父目录排除后重新包含深层项目，以及命令行排除与文件否定规则叠加。

existing_tests.reason: 已有触发为根级通配排除后重新包含，断言候选出现；不等同于父目录排除后的深层重新包含。
已有非法命令行 glob 的失败和诊断断言，此基础部分无新增。

cases.title: 陈旧度、摘要、解释及筛选后的不完整告警一致
preconditions: 准备活动时间可控制的新旧项目，配置 stale_after_days=60，候选大小及项目总大小可核对。
注入稳定遍历错误；权限夹具仅在适用平台以非特权身份使用。
准备能够过滤出错候选的大小或类别条件。
steps: 比较人工与 JSON 扫描的候选、字节数及陈旧度。
执行 explain，核对分类原因和恢复提示。
过滤出错候选后再次比较两种输出的告警含义。
核对 Biggest wins 的候选大小及项目产物百分比。
cases.expected_result: 人工输出有 Stale，JSON 有 staleAfterDays=60，并在可获得时报告相符的 stalenessDays。解释符合扫描分类，摘要数据与夹具一致。JSON 顶层 warnings 和人工摘要均保留实际错误及结果可能不完整的含义，不因候选被筛掉而隐藏错误。
cases.rationale: 迁移历史报告中筛选参数改变不完整告警的触发条件，不迁移分页、招聘平台或编辑配置建议。
cases.incremental_value: 补充陈旧度、解释、百分比和类别筛选分支；大小筛选后保留告警已有覆盖。

existing_tests.reason: 不可读目录触发遍历错误后，大小筛选排除候选仍保留 warnings，并检查人工不完整提示；没有陈旧度、解释及百分比断言。

cases.title: 按阶段断管保护删除边界并保留既定退出状态
preconditions: 具备可控制关闭时机的消费者或输出故障注入设施，直接收集生产者退出状态。
准备成功清理及稳定失败的隔离夹具，保存候选内容。
支持注入非 EPIPE 写错误；Unix 可控制继承的 SIGPIPE 状态。
steps: 读取 rules 和 scan 部分输出后关闭消费者，检查 stderr 和状态。
在 clean 删除前输出阶段断管，比较候选内容。
在清理已完成、退出状态已确定而摘要尚未写完时断管，分别测试成功和失败夹具。
独立注入非 EPIPE stdout 写错误。
cases.expected_result: 断管无 panic、backtrace 或异常崩溃。删除前断管保留全部候选内容；删除完成后的断管保留原计算状态，失败不能变成功。其他 stdout I/O 错误明确失败；不照搬其他产品的 141 退出约定。
cases.rationale: 迁移下游关闭、继承 SIGPIPE 状态和管道掩盖失败的触发线索。所给 Codewhale 测试关闭的是 MCP 子进程 stdin，不等同于 stdout 消费者关闭；rtk 非断管写错误 PR 未合并，只作为边界提案证据。
cases.incremental_value: 新增部分读取后关闭、清理完成后的成功与失败状态及非断管错误；现有夹具在启动前关闭读端。

existing_tests.reason: 表明断管发生在命令启动前，没有覆盖运行中或删除完成后关闭。
覆盖启动前断管时永久清理退出 0、无输出 panic 且候选存在；未断言内容逐字不变或完成后的失败状态。
